Secel makes her way to where she laid down before and drops to her knees. Grabbing hold of her necklace, she begins to pray. 

“Athena, daughter of Zues and Metis, queen of wisdom, warrior of the heavens above, I pray for your forgiveness. Last night, I gave in. Gave in to my hate, my rage, my Infernal blood. I felt the corruption coming closer, and…” she trails off, then starts again. “I wish to right my wickedness. I pray I have not fallen from your blessings, and that I am able to return to you if I have.” She paused again, taking in a deep breath. “I would also wish that… that if I am too far gone, that…” She choked on the words. She then sighed. “I am sorry..”

She then laid on her back, pulling off the hat and setting it on her chest as she looked at the stars…
